metadata.description: Grep-able indexes of the markdown records that pile up in a repo, for agents and operators alike.

plugins.name: card-catalog
plugins.description: Keeps a one-line-per-record INDEX.md next to each collection of records (ADRs by default) in sync as records are written, so agents can find prior records by grepping it.

plugins.name: card-catalog-helpers
plugins.description: Skills and an agent that use card-catalog in a conversation: add-collection sets up a collection, records-doctor fixes what validate reports, and precedent-finder finds the records a planned change touches. Installs the matching card-catalog plugin.
